reason: Test-only: two phone e2e assertions that could not fail now check what they name. The read-only Inspector test compared the graph with itself after the sheet was opened and closed; it now compares it with the graph taken before the first tap. The tour-over-a-selection test read a missing panel button as "not inert", the expected value; a missing button is now its own answer, and a real tap where Details and Deselect are drawn under the tour must open no sheet and take no selection off. Nothing in the app changes.
